text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I want the same specs. Size 9, but made of leather, and they need to be waterproof. That's what I asked for. No, that doesn't work for me. I need the exact same thing, just new. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 好的，就像我刚才告诉你的。我想要相同的规格。9码，但要做成皮革的，而且需要防水。这就是我要求的。不，那不适合我。我需要完全相同的东西，只是新的。我能和一位能真正解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
